SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
3841-43 N. Lakewood

The Applicant seeks to rezone 3843 North Lakewood from a RI-3.5 Residential Two-Flat,
Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a RM-5 Multi-Unit District to divide the zoning lot and
improve a vacant lot with a new detached house. Currently, the subject property is improved
with a three-story, three-flat building. The Applicant seeks to bring the existing building into a
conforming zoning district and construct a detached house on the vacant lot. No commercial

space will be provided.

The Applicant requires relief for both the existing building at the 3843 N. Lakewood and the
proposed construction at the 3841 N. Lakewood

3843. N. Lakewood Avenue (existing building): Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D,
Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to reduce the bike parking spaces from 3 to
0 under Section 17-13-1003-G; the Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the front setback
to 3.25 feet, the rear setback to 13.25 feet, the north, south, and combined setbacks to 0 feet
under Section 17-13-1101-B; the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to reduce
the rear yard open space to 0 square feet under Section 17-13-1003-K; and, the Applicant
seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.

3841 N. Lakewood Avenue (proposed construction): Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D,
the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to increase the parking spaces from 1 to
2 under Section 17-13-1003-EE; the Applicant seeks the following variation relief: (1), the
Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the front setback to 4 feet, 9 inches and to reduce the
rear setback to 15.5 feet; the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to reduce the
required minimum rear yard open space from 130 square feet to 0 square feet under
Section 17-13-1003-K; and, the Applicant seeks all relief as needed, as allowed by the
Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.
